Standard analysis, reporting and R code for Science.
- Reproducibility.
- Transparency.
- Open Access.
:::
::: {.column width="33%"}
```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
# Cargar la librería si no está cargada
library(fontawesome)
library(htmltools)

# Definir iconos con tamaño fijo pero contenedor flexible
rscience_icon <- tags$img(src = logo_path, style = "height: 24px; width: auto;")
github_icon   <- fa("github", fill = "#333333", height = "24px")
linkedin_icon <- fa("linkedin", fill = "#0077B5", height = "24px")
youtube_icon  <- fa("youtube", fill = "#FF0000", height = "24px")

# Enlaces simples
rscience_link <- tags$a(href = "https://google.com/", target = "_blank", rscience_icon)
github_link <- tags$a(href = "https://github.com/", target = "_blank", github_icon)
linkedin_link <- tags$a(href = "https://www.linkedin.com/in/deliaspanigo/", target = "_blank", linkedin_icon)
youtube_link <- tags$a(href = "https://www.youtube.com/", target = "_blank", youtube_icon)

# Contenedor ultra simple
div(
  style = "
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 20px;
    padding: 15px;
    margin: 20px auto;
    max-width: 100%;
  ",
  rscience_link,
  github_link,
  linkedin_link,
  youtube_link
)
```
